about.title: About Juniper Lawns
text: We are a team of lawn care professionals, here to assist with your residential or commercial lawn care needs. Juniper Lawns was started in early 2023 in Liberty Hill due to our love for beautiful, golf course quality lawns, for which Hill Country has perfect potential, but has a shortage of professional lawn care providers.

We focus on premium properties for clients wanting to bring their outside living spaces to the next level, and on clients needing to revive their lawns due to extended vacations or due to subpar work done by previous contractors. We specialize in premium landscape management and full service lawn care, and speciality lawn mowing services (scalping and reel mowing).

Our landscaping work emphasizes working with nature rather then trying to fight it, which creates seamless transitions from your well manicured immediate lawn, to the transitional area, and further out to the untouched nature.
